summary: Lån & Spar Bank A/S provides various banking products and services in Denmark. The company offers deposits, savings, student, grandchild, budget, salary, and payment accounts; private, car, caravan, motorcycle, housing, mortgage, cottage, business, and energy loans; cards; and payment services. It also provides pension and investment products; and private, life, health, and other insurance products, as well as online and mobile banking services. Lån & Spar Bank A/S was founded in 1880 and is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark.
